primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Successful transition was based on the number of participants that completely transitioned to oral treprostinil by the week 4 study visit and clinically maintained on oral treprostinil treatment through Week 24.

groups.description: UT-15C SR: Subjects will transition in the hospital from Remodulin to UT-15C SR within 5 days of the start of the transition. The dose of Remodulin will be decreased as the dose of UT-15C SR is increased over the 5 days. Once subjects have been transitioned from Remodulin, the dose of UT-15C SR will continue to be modified / titrated to the appropriate optimal dose for that subject throughout the rest of the study.
groups.title: UT-15C SR

primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Number of Participants That Were Succesfully Transitioned From Parenteral Remodulin to UT-15C.
